title: 第15章 美女村医贾慧珍第16章 效果拔群
slug: 赵老驴和杏花村的女人们
content_zh:
“再怎么样我也是女孩子……”
李翠翠扭扭捏捏，脸颊红的都快滴血了。
“好了好了，不说这些了，既然你没事那咱们现在就下山。后山危险的很，有好多野兽，咱们还是快点回村子吧。”
赵大柱说罢就捡起篮子朝着来路走去。
李翠翠虽然害羞的不得了，但她立即就追上赵大柱，与他一起下山。
眼看着都到山脚下了，都回到村子里了，李翠翠忽然拉了拉赵大柱的衣服袖子小声说道：“赵大爷，咱两在山上的事儿，你可不能跟别人说。我……我将来还要结婚嫁人呢，你要是败坏我的名声，我就嫁不出去了。”
“你别说的好像咱两在山上做了什么不得了的事情一样行不行？”赵大柱哭笑不得。
李翠翠再不好意思说话了，撒腿就跑。
赵大柱也没有再磨蹭，提着篮子往家里赶去。
回到家之后第一件事，就是给银环灵花称重。
确定了自己采摘的银环灵花的重量以后，赵大柱就知道需要多少辅药了。
他于是进了屋找到纸笔，回忆着传承里的速生灵散药方，刷刷刷的写下了一张方子。
这张方子上面罗列的全是配制速生灵散所需的各种辅药，而且还有具体的分量。
写好以后检查了几遍确定纰漏，赵大柱就兴冲冲的拿着药方来到了村口的小诊所。
“贾大夫，给我抓药。”
赵大柱将自己写的方字往玻璃柜台上一拍，坐在柜台后面用笔记本电脑看电视剧的女大夫便好奇的看了过来。
这个女大夫看上去也就三十出头的年纪，而且明眸皓齿，美艳的不得了。
她叫贾慧珍，并不是杏花村本地人。
她是五六年前来到杏花村的，出资建设了这个小诊所，然后就在这里当村医。
刚开始村里人对她好奇的很，不过时间长了也就不新鲜了。

但有一说一，这个女医生真的很热心肠，她治病收取的费用一直都很低，给村民开的药也都是最常见最普通同时还能把病治好的药。
村里人只要谈论起她，就没有不竖大拇指的。
杏花村的村民甚至觉得，这个女医生不是为了赚钱才来这里看病，她是上天派来的女菩萨，专门到人间做善事的。
正是因此，贾慧珍在杏花村里拥有十分超然的地位，哪怕是王建国这个狗村长见了她，也得客客气气的说话。
“这是你自己开的方子？你给谁开的？”贾慧珍好奇的问。
赵大柱笑着说道：“贾大夫你误会了，这不是给人治病的方子。”
“不是给人治病那是干什么的？”贾慧珍又问。
content_en:
"No matter what, I am still a girl..."
Li Cuicui was squirming, her cheeks so red that they were almost bleeding.
"Okay, okay, let's not talk about this anymore. Since you are fine, let's go down the mountain now. The back mountain is very dangerous and there are many wild animals. Let's go back to the village quickly."
After Zhao Dazhu said that, he picked up the basket and walked towards the way he came.
Although Li Cuicui was extremely shy, she immediately caught up with Zhao Dazhu and went down the mountain with him.
Seeing that they were all at the foot of the mountain and back in the village, Li Cuicui suddenly pulled the sleeves of Zhao Dazhu's clothes and whispered: "Uncle Zhao, you can't tell others what happened between us on the mountain. I...I will get married in the future. If you ruin my reputation, I won't be able to get married."
"Can you please stop making it sound like the two of us did something terrible on the mountain?" Zhao Dazhu couldn't laugh or cry.
Li Cuicui was no longer embarrassed to speak, so she ran away.
Zhao Dazhu didn't hesitate any longer and hurried home with the basket in hand.
The first thing I did after returning home was to weigh the white ring flower.
After determining the weight of the white ring flower he picked, Zhao Dazhu knew how much auxiliary medicine was needed.
So he went into the house and found a pen and paper, recalled the Sushengling Powder prescription in the inheritance, and wrote down a prescription.
This recipe lists all the auxiliary ingredients needed to prepare Sushengling Powder, and they also have specific weights.
After writing it and checking it several times to make sure there were no mistakes, Zhao Dazhu happily took the prescription to the small clinic at the entrance of the village.
"Doctor Jia, give me some medicine."
Zhao Dazhu slapped the square characters he wrote on the glass counter, and the female doctor sitting behind the counter watching TV series on her laptop looked over curiously.
This female doctor looks to be in her early thirties, with bright eyes and white teeth, and is extremely beautiful.
Her name is Jia Huizhen, and she is not a native of Xinghua Village.
She came to Xinghua Village five or six years ago, financed the construction of this small clinic, and then worked as a village doctor here.
At first, the people in the village were very curious about her, but as time went by, she became stale.
But one thing to say is that this female doctor is really warm-hearted. The fees she charges for treatment are always very low, and the medicines she prescribes to the villagers are the most common and common medicines that can also cure diseases.
Whenever people in the village talk about her, they all give a thumbs up.
The villagers of Xinghua Village even felt that this female doctor did not come here to treat patients just to make money. She was a female Bodhisattva sent by God to do good deeds in the world.
It is precisely because of this that Jia Huizhen has a very transcendent status in Xinghua Village. Even Wang Jianguo, the head of the dog village, has to speak politely to her when he meets her.
"This is a prescription you prescribed yourself? Who did you prescribe it for?" Jia Huizhen asked curiously.
Zhao Dazhu said with a smile: "Dr. Jia, you have misunderstood. This is not a prescription for treating people's illnesses."
"What do you do if you don't treat people?" Jia Huizhen asked again.
